items.title: 🔎 Under the Radar: Legend Stock Tumbles After CEO Departs
items.summary: Shares of Legend Biotech fell 14% Monday after the company announced that CEO Ying Huang stepped down and left the board.  Legend said in a regulatory filing that Huang’s resignation was not the result of a disagreement with the company, but didn’t say anything more about why he left.  Huang said he was departing the company to work with a venture fund focusing on drug development.
